title: 8-time Pro Bowl DE Cameron Jordan announces he's returning to Saints for 'one final season'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 8-time Pro Bowl DE Cameron Jordan announces he's returning to Saints for 'one final season'
sources.description: Jordan has spent all 15 of his NFL seasons in New Orleans. He'll be 37 years old by the time the 2026 campaign begins.
